title: pyrus capsicina
intro: Pyrus capsicina, commonly known as wild pear or mountain pear, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Pyrus capsicina include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit analgesic and anti-inflammatory activities. The bioactive constituents of Pyrus capsicina include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
